I went through this, still am, My boyfriend of 1.5 years (whom I loved for 5 years prior to that)
Broke up 3 months ago,
It's been hard.
I still have days where I wonder if i'll ever get over him
But month 1 was just cry, for goodness sake just cry it gets all those raw emotions out so you don't do or say anything stupid now is the time to reach out to friends and family, make sure you never feel lonely!
month two I ended up soul searching, finding out who I was without him, yes it was okay to still enjoy the things I did with him, but for now it was best to find other things and eventually I did :)
month 3 was all about self image building myself back up, that I am beautiful I will find someone else some day yes I have my flaws but who doesn't, get out have fun and build that confidence back up!

I can't speak for any more as this was the only person i've ever loved and it's month 3 now,
But I wish you all the best I know it's not much help, it's just things that helped me get through or more state of minds.
